# polyhedra.library: Expand

**Status:** Supported (tier `geometry`). In a shipping tier; the lint, type-check, and code-generation gates cover it. No release promises its signature yet.

## Summary

> Expand (cantellation, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cantellation\_(geometry)):
> faces shrink in place, a quad appears per edge, an n-gon per degree-n
> vertex. Cube -> rhombicuboctahedron at shrink = sqrt(2) - 1.
> V' = C, E' = 2E + C, F' = F + V + E.

## Signature

```plato
Expand(self: PolygonMesh3D, shrink: Number): PolygonMesh3D
```

// Expanding outward by a non-negative amount still contains the original box.

    => b.IsEmpty || b.Expand(1.0).Contains(b);

```plato

    //==
    // The operators.

    // Expand (cantellation, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cantellation_(geometry)):
    // faces shrink in place, a quad appears per edge, an n-gon per degree-n
    // vertex. Cube -> rhombicuboctahedron at shrink = sqrt(2) - 1.
    // V' = C, E' = 2E + C, F' = F + V + E.
    Expand(self: PolygonMesh3D, shrink: Number): PolygonMesh3D
        => PolygonMeshOfFaces(
            self.TwistedFacePoints(shrink, Angle(0.0)),
            self.ExpansionFaces((m, c) => [m.ExpandFaceOfEdge(c)]));
```
